reason: A DeepSeek Harness Web plugin that visualizes account balance, estimated usage, spending, token statistics, and optional invoice history in an interactive statistics bar and details card.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 中展示余额、会话费用、累计支出、令牌用量及可选账单历史的统计插件。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness Web plugin that displays balance, session cost, total spending, token usage, and optional invoice history.

capabilities: Reads DeepSeek balance data through an external API
Estimates session and historical usage from local Harness logs
Displays balance, spending, invoice, model, and token statistics
Optionally accepts and stores a DeepSeek Platform user token for invoice retrieval
Persists imported invoice summaries and refreshes data on configured intervals
